seo.title: Book a Table — Potli Hammersmith
seo.description: Book a table at Potli, Indian market kitchen on King Street, Hammersmith. Real-time availability and instant confirmation.
seo.ogDescription: Real-time table availability and instant confirmation at Potli.

heading: Book a Table
intro: Pick a date and time — if you can select it, the table is yours.
slotHint: Lunch runs from 12:00, dinner from 17:00. If the time you want isn't listed, call us and we'll find you a table.
partyHint: Tables for 1 to 30. Our private dining room seats 30.

afterSubmit.heading: You're Booked In!
afterSubmit.body: We can't wait to feed you. We'll confirm by phone if anything needs changing.
afterSubmit.footnote: Need to change anything? Call us on 020 8741 4328 with your reference.

sidebar.heading: Large parties
sidebar.body: For groups over 10, or for the private dining room, call us on 020 8741 4328 and we'll take the booking over the phone.
